campus_notes: Compiled 2026-11-26 from UNG Residence Life (ung.edu/residence-life) and the Corps of Cadets housing pages. UNG has several campuses, including Gainesville, but Residence Life states "Residency is only offered at the Dahlonega Campus", so every hall here is on the Dahlonega campus. Non-cadets live in North Georgia Suites, Donovan Hall, Lewis Hall, Lewis Annex, Owen Hall and The Commons; the Corps of Cadets lives in the Military Village (Gaillard, Liberty and Patriot halls). Each Residence Life hall page has a furniture-measurement table (UNG calls the measurements approximate) that gives the bedroom size for one room type, plus labeled floor plans; those sizes are used as published, with plan-derived sizes at medium confidence. Patriot Hall's sizes come from its Residence Life page as archived in July 2025. Gaillard Hall, Liberty Hall, The Commons and the North Georgia Suites single publish no usable size and use the estimate fallback. Every room has a Twin XL mattress; bed risers are prohibited.

dorms.notes: Five-story brick building with 76 four-bedroom, two-bath apartments (single-sex apartments, co-ed building). Upperclassmen and limited freshmen; non-cadets only; meal plan optional. Each apartment has a kitchen (refrigerator, stove, dishwasher, table with four chairs) and a living room (sofa, chair, coffee table, end table, entertainment center). The elevator stops at the 1500s floor; the 1600s floor is reached by stairs.
